'''Lithium Magna''' was a manufactured substance that was available on the black market and which could be combined with the chemical catalyst [[Lucogen]] to form a binary explosive. During a banquet in the [[Popara's penthouse|penthouse]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto|Popara Anjiliac]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], Popara's son [[Mika (Farghul)|Mika]] sought to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] his father and arranged for Popara to be given some wine that contained traces of Lithium Magna. Popara subsequently dined on several worms that were laced with Lucogen, and the Lithium Magna combined with the Lucogen and caused Popara to explode.
